title: NVDA Stock Alert: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Says Chips Are ‘Investable Asset Class’
excerpt: Nvidia is reshaping the AI investment landscape as Jensen Huang positions its chips as an “investable asset class.”
content_html:
Subhasree Kar

Sat, August 15, 2026 at 6:00 AM PDT 5 min read

Nvidia Corporation (NVDA) is once again putting itself at the center of the artificial intelligence (AI) investment boom, but this time the story goes beyond selling high-performance chips. CEO Jensen Huang says AI compute is becoming an "investable asset class," as the company works together with some of the world's largest financial institutions to mobilize more than $500 billion in third-party capital for AI infrastructure.

Nvidia is partnering with six major asset managers: Apollo Global Management (APO), Blackstone (BX), BlackRock (BLK), Brookfield Asset Management (BAM), The Goldman Sachs Group (GS), and KKR & Co. (KKR), to mobilize more than $500 billion in financing for AI data centers and Nvidia hardware. The initiative aims to make AI computing infrastructure a financeable, revenue-generating asset similar to commercial real estate or other long-term infrastructure.

CEO Jensen Huang argues that Nvidia chips are now productive, long-lived, transferable and increasingly essential to modern infrastructure, challenging the traditional view that GPUs rapidly depreciate. The financing could help hyperscalers, AI labs and enterprises fund massive AI investments without relying entirely on their own balance sheets.

Many experts are now seeing the effort as a potential new asset class and a major development in financial engineering. However, the strategy faces questions over whether GPUs can retain value as newer chip generations emerge and as Big Tech's huge AI capital expenditures put pressure on cash flows.

About Nvidia Stock

Nvidia is a global leader in accelerated computing and AI, renowned for pioneering the GPU that revolutionized gaming, data centers, and AI-driven computing. Headquartered in Santa Clara, California, Nvidia's technology now powers everything from high-performance gaming and cloud computing to autonomous vehicles and generative AI applications. With a market cap of $5.4 trillion, Nvidia stands among the world's most valuable companies, driven by its dominance in AI infrastructure and continued innovation in next-generation chip design.

苏巴斯里·卡尔

太平洋夏令时间 2026 年 8 月 15 日星期六上午 6:00 阅读 5 分钟

英伟达公司（NVDA）再次将自己置于人工智能（AI）投资热潮的中心，但这一次的故事不仅仅是销售高性能芯片。 首席执行官黄仁勋表示，随着该公司与一些全球最大的金融机构合作，为人工智能基础设施动员超过 5000 亿美元的第三方资本，人工智能计算正在成为一种“可投资资产类别”。

Nvidia 正在与六家主要资产管理公司合作：阿波罗全球管理公司 (APO)、黑石 (BX)、贝莱德 (BLK)、布鲁克菲尔德资产管理公司 (BAM)、高盛集团 (GS) 和 KKR & Co。 (KKR)，为人工智能数据中心和 Nvidia 硬件筹集超过 5000 亿美元的融资。 该计划旨在使人工智能计算基础设施成为类似于商业房地产或其他长期基础设施的可融资、创收资产。

首席执行官黄仁勋认为，Nvidia 芯片现在生产力高、寿命长、可转让，并且对现代基础设施越来越重要，挑战了 GPU 快速贬值的传统观点。 此次融资可以帮助超大规模企业、人工智能实验室和企业为大规模人工智能投资提供资金，而无需完全依赖自己的资产负债表。

许多专家现在将这一努力视为一种潜在的新资产类别和金融工程的重大发展。 然而，随着新一代芯片的出现以及大型科技公司巨额人工智能资本支出给现金流带来压力，该战略面临着 GPU 能否保持价值的问题。

关于英伟达股票

Nvidia 是加速计算和人工智能领域的全球领导者，因开创 GPU 领域而闻名，彻底改变了游戏、数据中心和人工智能驱动的计算。 Nvidia 总部位于加利福尼亚州圣克拉拉，其技术现已为从高性能游戏和云计算到自动驾驶汽车和生成式人工智能应用程序的各个领域提供支持。 凭借在人工智能基础设施领域的主导地位和下一代芯片设计的持续创新，英伟达市值达 5.4 万亿美元，跻身全球最有价值的公司之列。
